up: Find all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1148785'. For each compound, return the following columns: the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum development phase (max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). If the same compound appears multiple times in that document, include it only once. Sort the results in ascending order by the compound's ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1148785' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
